thesis_or_claim: Signed mission-critical backlog converts to cash
observable_breaker: Signed backlog fails to convert to revenue and collection while combined or future-phase visibility remains high
measurement_or_trigger: Reconcile signed backlog roll-forward; recognized revenue; contract assets/liabilities; retainage; receivables; and collections by same period
next_document: Next Sterling 10-Q and project or customer collection schedule

thesis_or_claim: Percentage-of-completion estimates reflect durable project economics
observable_breaker: Adverse estimate revisions, unapproved claims, or contract assets/retainage rise without corresponding margin and cash
measurement_or_trigger: Compare cost-to-complete revisions; claims; estimate changes; project margin; contract assets; retainage; and final settlement
next_document: Next Sterling 10-Q or project closeout disclosure

thesis_or_claim: CEC and Stone Ridge create value above acquisition burden
observable_breaker: Post-close cash contribution fails the cash/stock/earn-out return hurdle
measurement_or_trigger: Join acquired revenue; margin; working capital; integration; earn-outs; dilution; and post-close cash to acquisition consideration

thesis_or_claim: Reported conversion persists through the operating cycle
observable_breaker: OCF less productive/property spend deteriorates after receivable, inventory, supplier-term, and customer-mix normalization
measurement_or_trigger: Compare same-period OCF; property spend; collections; inventory; payables; supplier finance; service; lease; tax; and diluted-owner claims
next_document: Next comparable WESCO and Fastenal quarterly filings

thesis_or_claim: Embedded replenishment economics support recurring owner cash
observable_breaker: Onsite/digital/service growth is accompanied by weaker cash conversion or rising unallocated service and maintenance burden
measurement_or_trigger: Reconcile customer/channel growth; service costs; inventory economics; lease additions; property spend; taxes; dilution; and cash
next_document: Next Fastenal quarterly filing and service/channel disclosure

observable_breaker: Fleet productivity or used-equipment recovery fails to support replacement investment and debt claims
measurement_or_trigger: Compare OCF; rental-equipment purchases; resale proceeds; utilization/productivity; maintenance; debt; and replacement-capex classification
next_document: Next URI quarterly filing and fleet/capital-allocation disclosure

thesis_or_claim: Public liquidity proxy represents durable legal capacity
observable_breaker: Populated certificate shows lower eligible collateral, NOLV, reserves, or availability than the public proxy
measurement_or_trigger: Reconcile facility balance; eligible collateral; NOLV; reserves; L/Cs; Combined Availability; and source-to-purchase use
next_document: Populated URI borrowing-base certificate or lender collateral report
